purpose: Analyze a music track and return timing landmarks for Black Red Line video editing.

input.file: audio binary: mp3/wav/aac where decoder support is available

director_rules: Video movement and exercise readability have priority over beat matching.
Never cut a repetition at a mechanically confusing point only to hit a beat.
Prefer DROP/BASS_PEAK/STRONG_BEAT for major cuts or movement starts.
Treat DROP and TRANSITION as heuristic candidates, not guaranteed musical semantics.
Use only factual weight/reps/sets supplied by the user or verified from project data.
